card.name: Thirty-two integers with many distinct 3-term progression differences

task.name: Thirty-two integers with many distinct 3-term progression differences
task.description: construct() -> exactly 32 distinct integers in 1..512. The score is the number of distinct d > 0 such that a, a + d, a + 2d all lie in the set for some a. Maximize. A 32-element set with many progression differences is a finite construction for this extremal function.
